## Overview

This 2026-09-15 PayCo iOS page is a navigation chooser. It links method-specific Drop-in and Components guides plus four main iOS integration routes. It does not itself document setup conditions or a transaction result. [[adyen]] [[adyen-online-payments]]

## Key takeaways

- **Method-guide options:** the page presents an all-in-one iOS Drop-in route and an iOS Components route labeled for `InstantPaymentComponent`. These labels route readers to child guides; this chooser does not state a Component version, action type, request fields, test credentials or shopper behavior. (raw lines 19–27)
- **Main integration first:** it tells readers to create the main integration before adding PayCo, linking iOS Drop-in and Components for both Sessions and Advanced flows. The four links do not establish that each child path has the same prerequisites or outcome behavior. (raw lines 29–36)
- **Evidence limit:** this page has no Korea/currency/entity eligibility detail, KCP/card-link procedure, redirect return, 3DS, webhook, authorization, capture or settlement evidence. The selected child and base guide govern those questions. (raw lines 15–36)

## Detail locators

- Drop-in and `InstantPaymentComponent` child-guide labels: raw lines 19–27.
- Main Sessions and Advanced iOS routes: raw lines 29–36.
